name: aura-monorepo
description: aura — a simple-surface, deep-core astrology app on a real Vedic engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/engine && npm run test --workspace packages/knowledge && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run test --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/knowledge && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api
